experiment_id.description: Unique ID for this experiment run

template_name.description: Name of the experiment template used

intervention.description: What was changed from the baseline for this experiment

transactions_created.description: Number of transaction records in the store after the experiment

duplicate_count.description: Number of excess transactions beyond expected (transactions_created - 1)

retry_log_entries.description: Log of retry events observed during the experiment

backend_calls.description: Total number of calls made to the mock backend

result.description: Outcome of the experiment with respect to the hypothesis

reason.description: Explanation of why the hypothesis was FALSIFIED or SUPPORTED

raw_evidence.description: Raw transaction records from the store

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the experiment ran
